c.st: Technical Writing Courses
c.x: The trick to writing that works for me is to combine tips 2 and 3 iteratively. I don’t write concisely at first (and I think that’s the case for most people), so I just write down everything I can think of related to the topic, even all the edge cases. Then I go back and simplify, maybe focus on a relevant example. I cut out fluff and stick to that example, perhaps with the list of edge cases in a separate section (and call it “Advanced Use Cases”).
